intro: Start with free basic analysis and public market quotes. Add your own model key for AI analysis, or a Finnhub key for extra company data and news.
readyBody: Basic analysis checks public prices, portfolio exposure and configured risk rules. Its report shows the rules and data used; it is not a language-model opinion.
basicScope: Active by default when no model key is configured. Save a working model key below to upgrade future runs to AI analysis automatically. Existing reports keep their original method.
llmScope: Your model handles analysis inside Squabble. No separate agent app is needed. Reports follow the language selected when a run starts and show evidence, arguments and decision summaries.
publicScope: Public providers supply US, Hong Kong and mainland China quotes without a key. Quotes can be delayed or unavailable; missing data stays visible instead of being invented.
financialUpgrade: Add Finnhub to enrich supported US stock research with company metrics and news. It does not replace the public quote feed or add HK/CN fundamentals. Coverage and quotas depend on your Finnhub plan.
presetHint: Presets edit the form only; review the endpoint and model IDs, add your provider key, then save. OpenRouter free models require your own key and have usage limits.
deepSeekModelHint: DeepSeek API IDs are deepseek-flash and deepseek-v4-pro. The DeepSeek preset fills both fields with deepseek-flash for lower-cost calls; you can choose deepseek-v4-pro for the research tier. Enter an API ID, not a display name such as “DeepSeek V4.1 Flash”. Check the official model list for current availability.
deepSeekModeHint: Council and connection-test calls to the official DeepSeek endpoint use explicit non-thinking mode for these current model IDs, within your existing output cap. Existing saved models stay unchanged until you save. Empty or truncated replies stop the task without a paid fallback; spent or reserved usage remains counted.
providerChanged: Enter a new API key when changing providers. The saved key will not be sent to another endpoint.
removeLlm: Your personal model key and settings will be removed. Future runs use the server model if configured, otherwise free basic analysis. Existing reports are retained.
removeFinancial: Your Finnhub key will be removed. Free public quotes remain active; company metrics and news that require Finnhub will be marked as unavailable.
guideIntro: No setup is needed for basic analysis. Optional keys add AI models and financial evidence. Provider links below open official documentation.
guideDefaultStep1: Leave the API fields empty and open Daily Analysis. Choose stocks and select Run analysis. You do not need to open Doubao or another agent app.
guideDefaultStep2: Select Chinese or English before starting. That choice is saved with the run. Read the data sources, risk checks and limitations in its report.
guideDefaultStep3: Basic mode has no model API charges. Public quotes can be delayed, rate-limited or unavailable. If an input is missing, the report says so; it does not invent news or valuations.
guideFreeTitle: 2. Add a model with a free quota (optional)
guideFreeStep1: Create an OpenRouter account and API key. You still need your own key even when the selected model is free.
guideFreeStep2: Select OpenRouter free models above, or enter https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 as the base URL and openrouter/free in both model fields. Paste the key, save and test the connection.
guideFreeStep3: OpenRouter currently documents 20 requests/minute and 50 requests/day for free variants without a credit purchase. One multi-agent run makes several requests. Limits and model availability can change; check the official page.
guideFreeStep4: With a configured key, new runs use that model. A rejected key or exhausted quota produces an error, rather than silently switching to basic mode. Remove your key to return to the default.

test.basic_ready: Basic analysis is ready. It uses data and rules, with no language model or model API charges.
test.public_ready: The public feed returned an AAPL quote. No API key is required.
test.public_unavailable: Public quote providers are unavailable. Retry after checking the server network.
test.credential_unreadable: The saved API key cannot be read. Re-enter it or remove the connection.
